summary: Targeted responsive retest of the single MEDIUM bug from iteration_11 on /developers. The fix (DevNav inline section nav changed from 'hidden md:flex' to 'hidden lg:flex') is VERIFIED. All three viewports now pass with scrollWidth === clientWidth (zero horizontal overflow). Tablet 768 hides section nav (why/trust/status) and shows only logo + Demo + Admin + API Docs. Desktop 1920 keeps section nav visible. Mobile 390 has no overflow and the full Try-It-Live lifecycle (sandbox key -> proof -> verify-outcome 'Proof is authentic & untampered') still completes end-to-end. Key sections (dev-hero, dev-playground, dev-trust-architecture, dev-platform-status) render at every width. 4/4 retest checks pass.

Screenshot confirms clean header layout (logo on left, Demo/Admin/API Docs on right).
DESKTOP 1920x1080: scrollWidth=1920 === clientWidth=1920 (no overflow). dev-nav-why, dev-nav-trust (Security), dev-nav-status, dev-nav-demo, dev-nav-admin, dev-nav-api-docs ALL visible.

MOBILE 390x844: scrollWidth=390 === clientWidth=390 (no overflow). Section nav links hidden; among the right-side actions only dev-nav-api-docs remains visible (Demo/Admin hidden below sm/lg). Full lifecycle PASSES: generate-sandbox-key-btn -> sandbox-key-result 'pfp_sandbox_087fcfac...' -> generate-proof-btn -> first-proof-result (fea_id d64c089a-76f6-4e3d-86bc-6640402b87ab) -> verify-proof-btn -> verify-outcome exactly contains 'Proof is authentic & untampered'.
Regression: dev-hero, dev-playground, dev-trust-architecture, dev-platform-status render at all three viewports (tablet/desktop/mobile).
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is minimal and correct: section nav uses 'hidden lg:flex' so it only renders at >=1024px, eliminating the 768px overflow. Tablet header is now compact (logo + Demo + Admin + API Docs).

Minor consideration (LOW): At tablet, users have no in-page section navigation (Why/Security/Status). Acceptable since the sections are still reachable via scrolling and CTAs; only flag if product wants a tablet hamburger menu later.

context_for_next_testing_agent: DevNav breakpoint strategy after fix: section nav links (dev-nav-why/why-not/how/playground/trust/sdks/status) use 'hidden lg:flex' (visible >=1024px). dev-nav-demo uses 'hidden md:inline-flex' and dev-nav-admin uses 'hidden sm:inline-flex' (so at mobile 390 only the dev-nav-api-docs button shows on the right; this is intended). All three target widths (390/768/1920) have scrollW === clientW. The single MEDIUM responsive bug from iteration_11 is resolved.
rca of the issue: RCA confirmed for the fix: previously 'hidden md:flex' caused 7 section links to render at 768px alongside Demo+Admin+API Docs, pushing scrollWidth to 934. Changing to 'hidden lg:flex' raises the breakpoint to >=1024px so the section links only appear on desktop. Tablet now renders only the right cluster (Demo + Admin + API Docs ~ within 768px) and produces scrollW=768, clientW=768. Verified at https://pfp-demo-portal.preview.emergentagent.com/developers.
